idea-plugin.name: Codebook
idea-plugin.description:
A JetBrains IDE plugin (CLion, PyCharm, IntelliJ IDEA) for code-based-learning courses: it turns didactic comments in course snippets into a structured side panel — and folds them away in the editor, so the code stays readable while the prose stays available.

See README for details.

Built for the code-based-learning courses at codebasedlearning.dev.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.4
  • common indent removed, no outline jump after run, and more

1.0.1 — first public release
  • Topic outline of a file's dash-framed block comments, with layered notes that follow the caret.
  • Markdown rendering (GitHub-flavoured, tables included), images, and links between topics.
  • Short glossary references: [#term] links and ![#term] embeds, resolved along a configurable search path.
  • Editor folding of the note body, leaving the title line visible; fold and unfold act on the topic comments only.
  • Run and Debug from the panel; gutter icons link printed output sections back to their source line.
  • Per-course configuration via cascading cbl.properties.
